content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to request one small adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, third-party liabilities and IP infringement are carved out of the liability cap and left uncapped, meaning there is unlimited financial exposure for these types of claims. I propose modifying this to state that the aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to moving ahead.
